R409.note: Replaces raw TcpClient wire writes with StackExchange.Redis's RESP-framed StringSet, correctly closing CRLF command injection; constructor signature change to IConnectionMultiplexer is disclosed and does not affect the shown caller.

R410.note: Normalizes destination once and resolves/checks with Path.startsWith (segment-aware, not string-prefix), correctly closing the traversal bypass while preserving multi-entry extraction.

R411.note: proc_open with argument array removes shell interpretation; verified empirically (php repro) that an empty descriptorspec still inherits stdout, matching original output behavior. Minor unaddressed residual: a leading '-' in host could still be read as a ping flag, not shell injection.

R412.note: Verified via a Go 1.25 reproduction that the zero-value http.CrossOriginProtection does not panic, allows same-origin/no-header requests, and rejects cross-site/mismatched-origin ones -- adds a stated extra layer without narrowing the existing Origin check.

R413.note: Per-member realpath containment check (is_relative_to) correctly rejects both absolute-path and relative-traversal Zip Slip entries before any bytes are written.

R414.note: Standard sprintf->snprintf bound-write fix; truncation-on-overflow behavior is disclosed.

R415.note: Eliminates the shell sink entirely via sharp, but the added geometry regex (WIDTHxHEIGHT only) is a new restriction not clearly required by the case's contract, silently narrower than ImageMagick's accepted geometry syntax (e.g. percentages) the original code accepted; disclosed but still a behavior narrowing.

R416.note: id = ANY($1) with array binding matches the stated contract exactly: any array of ids works, none can alter query structure.

R417.note: Build FAIL confirmed: SimpleEvaluationContext has no setRootObject method, so the fix does not compile and the endpoint would not build at all, undisclosed.

R418.note: Straightforward bounds check before the array write; only out-of-range (invalid/attacker) indices are silently dropped, valid indices unaffected.

R419.note: Verified by direct reproduction (Java on Windows) that array-form Runtime.exec() with cmd.exe /c dir <data> is still exploitable when the value contains a double-quote character (confirmed injected command executed); only the non-Windows /bin/ls branch is fully closed.

R420.note: Correct parameterized SqlCommand with the required 'using System.Data;' present; build OK confirms SqlDbType resolves.

R421.note: os.path.realpath resolves symlinks before the containment check, closing the reported symlink escape; contract (nested downloads, fail-closed, unchanged leaf filename) preserved. Minor caveat: REPORT_ROOT itself is computed via abspath not realpath, a latent inconsistency if the root path itself traverses a symlink, though not the scenario reported.

R422.note: Build FAIL confirmed: SqlDbType is referenced without 'using System.Data;', so the fix does not compile.

R423.note: Verified by direct EF Core/SQLite reproduction that ExecuteSqlRawAsync(sql, accountId, status, beforeUtc) with named placeholders (@accountId etc.) in raw SQL text throws InvalidOperationException ('Must add values for the following parameters: @accountId, @status, @beforeUtc') on every call -- EF Core only maps positional raw values to numbered {0}/{1} placeholders, not literal named ones, so this fix breaks the endpoint for all legitimate use, undisclosed.
